hook: A plasma wakefield compresses electron bunches, driving a free electron laser with far stronger pulses.
summary: The team used a plasma wakefield to chirp and compress a relativistic electron bunch without the usual loss of beam quality. The short bunch drove single-microbunch free electron lasing at optical wavelengths in a meter-scale undulator, with radiation pulses about four orders of magnitude more energetic than an earlier plasma-driven demonstration. It is one facility's demonstration, not yet a routine tool.
title: Compact plasma-based extreme compression of relativistic electron beams
